newsitem.title: UK: UK M0 falls to s/a 25.179 bln stg in week to May 7.
newsitem.headline: UK M0 falls to s/a 25.179 bln stg in week to May 7.

text.p: British M0 money supply fell to a provisional seasonally adjusted 25.179 billion stg in the week to May 7 from 25.203 billion the previous week, the Bank of England said.
On an unadjusted basis, M0 rose to 25.386 billion stg from 25.037 billion.
Notes and coins in circulation fell to a seasonally adjusted 25.059 billion stg from 25.182 billion the previous week but rose to 25.266 billion stg from 25.016 billion on an unadjusted basis.
